name: Idefix
about: Idefix (2026-236, CNES/DLR), launched 2026 Oct 19. Its phases from GCAT: HCO. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; carried by another craft, whose orbit this is
